chunks: But the Prophet and those who have embraced the faith with him, and have fought with their wealth and souls, are blessed and will be successful.

key_terms.جَاهَدُوا: They strove/fought (in the way of God)

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for those who fight with their wealth and souls alongside the Prophet?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to Surah 9:111 as a complementary promise, emphasizing that the Prophet and the faithful companions achieved 'al-khayrat' (comprehensive goodness) through the dual sacrifice of wealth and self. This highlights the concept of *jihād al-akbar* and *al-asghar*, where material and physical struggles are united under divine guidance to secure ultimate felicity (*al-muflihūn*).
